name: Single-leg deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips, reaching your hands toward the floor as your other leg lifts back.
Keep your back flat, then return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
cue: Hinge at the hips, back leg lifts
